title: two unrelated syntax errors in one file
note: Only ONE error is reported, deliberately: the missing semicolon after `attribute x : Real` is accepted by the parser's leniency (see L2-missing-semicolon), so the unknown keyword `blok` is the only real fault. FIXED 2026-09-02: error recovery used to re-home the declarations after the fault to the ROOT namespace; the post-parse re-homing pass now returns `C` to `package P`, which is why `rootsSurvive` is just `P`.
